text:
zoe_support: FYI from a support case — customer says their promo code SPRING50 failed at checkout. they're in Germany (EUR) and VAT shows on the invoice. error reported: \"code_invalid_for_region\". pasted the invoice snippet they sent below.

zoe_support: invoice lines: 
```
Currency: EUR
Subtotal: 40.00
VAT (19%): 7.60
Total: 47.60
Promo: SPRING50 -> rejected: code_invalid_for_region
```

sam_billing: from quick glance, SPRING50 is scoped to USD accounts only. promo service has allowed_currencies = [\"USD\"]. i can repro by creating a EUR test account.

sam_billing: repro steps i used:
1) create account with billing locale DE/EUR
2) call POST /v1/promos/apply { code: \"SPRING50\", account_id: \"acct-eur-test\" }
3) response: 400 { \"error\": \"code_invalid_for_region\", \"allowed_currencies\": [\"USD\"] }

promo-bot: Promo validation check: rule=currency_scope, code=SPRING50, allowed_currencies=[USD], allowed_regions=[US,CA].

ev an_ops: we should treat this as a customer-impacting edge case because EU VAT pushes subtotal under threshold when coupon is USD-only. two parallel actions: (1) immediate customer relief (manual credit) (2) product fix to promo validation/FAQ.

nina_finance: manual credit fine from finance side. need request id + reason. what was the original intended discount amount? SPRING50 is 50 USD off for new customers.

zoe_support: customer is new, expected 50 USD off. their subtotal 40 EUR (approx 43 USD), VAT bumped total to ~47.6 EUR (~51 USD). because code was USD-only, validation blocked it. customer message: \"we were billed full amount, can you apply the promo?\"

sam_billing: proposing we do two things:
- immediate: grant equivalent credit in EUR that matches 50 USD (use FX rate at time of charge) and mark invoice adjustment 
- longer: update promo service to allow currency conversion or to relax currency-scope for promos flagged as \"cross-border-friendly\"

nina_finance: OK i'll issue manual credit. pls provide: customer account id, invoice id, charge timestamp, and consent note. i'll need approval code reason: \"promo_applicability_currency_edge\".

zoe_support: account = acct-004512, invoice = inv-2026-03-12-4512, charge_ts = 1759992000, customer gave consent to apply credit.

nina_finance: issuing credit now for equivalent of 50 USD -> 47.80 EUR (FX 1 USD = 0.956 EUR). credit id = cred-2026-4512-1. will appear on their account within 24h. tagging for notes: #manual-credit #promo-edge

sam_billing: created GH issue and branch: GH-issue #4823 \"promo-service: support cross-currency promos / relax currency scope\" branch `fix/promo-currency-4823`. draft change:
```
// current: if (!allowed_currencies.includes(account.currency)) throw error
// proposed: if (!allowed_currencies.includes(account.currency)) {
//   if (promo.flags.cross_border) apply_fx_and_allow()
//   else throw error
// }
```

evan_ops: quick follow-up: need to update docs/FAQ and notify CS template. also patch tests for region/currency combos. once PR ready, let's canary behind a feature flag.

zoe_support: i'll reply to customer: we've applied a one-time manual credit equivalent to the promo, should reflect within 24h; engineering is working on a longer term fix; apologies for the trouble. :pray:

sam_billing: leaving note to billing logs: `case=promo-fail-currency acct=acct-004512 promo=SPRING50 action=manual-credit cred=cred-2026-4512-1`

nina_finance: closing out from finance side, will follow up if any chargeback needed.

promo-bot: Automated note: created ticket GH-4823, assigned to @sam_billing, severity=medium.

zoe_support: resolved for customer — closing thread. will add the customer-facing FAQ update to the support KB after the PR merges. :white_check_mark:
